Illinois Tech’s Master of Architecture (M.Arch)/Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.) dual-degree program is designed to prepare students to follow their passions.

Study with award-winning architects to build a solid foundation of skills and knowledge in architectural design. Develop high-level expertise in strategic management to can bring innovative leadership to organizations, projects, and initiatives. Plus, take advantage of Illinois Tech’s connections throughout Chicago, a global center for architecture and business that offers remarkable resources for experiential learning, expanding their professional network, and pursuing career opportunities.

The Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.) and Master of Public Administration (M.P.A.) dual-degree program at Illinois Institute of Technology’s Stuart School of Business is ideal for people who are currently in—or who aspire to—careers and professions that bridge the private and civic sectors.

Together, the Illinois Tech M.B.A. and M.P.A. degrees prepare students to be effective managers, decision-makers, and leaders, with a deep understanding of how to navigate both business and government to get things done.

The M.B.A program’s rigorous, tech-focused curriculum is designed to develop an innovation mindset and the intellectual agility to take on complex business challenges. Courses feature case studies, projects, and hands-on use of technology to build analytical, strategic, and managerial skills.

With the M.P.A. program’s applied approach, students will gain administrative knowledge and skills in public and nonprofit management, analytics, policy analysis, strategic planning, and effective implementation strategies.
